objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other controlled documents that go through creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document in the document pyramid (Level 1-4).

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short abbreviation prefix for the document type used in naming (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number per document type included in the document name.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document, automatically incremented upon revisions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document within the status network (e.g., editing, released, out of force).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document version is considered valid, set upon release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiration date based on Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable duration for which a document remains valid before requiring a validity check, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope or area of applicability of the document, printable via TAG technology.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or Master data maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies to which the document is relevant, maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Specific areas or regions where the document applies.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person registered as the primary author of the document, automatically set to the Creator.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling who has read access to the document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: User groups or persons informed by email notification upon release of a new version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups or persons required to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of in which clients of a multi-client system the document is visible.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the main document's release.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment, subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment, following the main document's release process statuses.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by authors to suggest changes to an existing document without affecting its content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document's validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate a released document that has no additional validity, triggering the archiving process.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request created to re-validate a previously invalidated document, restricted to the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users in the system used for assigning authorizations, reader access, and distribution list memberships.

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can be assigned roles and participate in document workflows.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list maintained per document specifying user groups and persons who are informed about document releases, either by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature provided by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow tasks during the release process.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity within the company to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process defined in process management to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object to which documents can be linked within the system.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: An IT application registered as Master data that can be referenced by documents.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational client in a multi-client system in which documents can be made visible or restricted.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user and role-specific view providing relevant document lists, status information, and evaluation reports.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation report with configurable selection parameters and criteria for searching and filtering documents in the system.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The specific type of report such as status report, search for documents, or acknowledgement report.

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Configurable parameters that influence evaluation results and filter result lists.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process flow that guides documents through approval steps including creation, review, and release.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The author edits the content of a document using the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The author or co-author maintains or modifies the metadata and attributes of a document via property editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts the saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document via the control (release) category.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The author or a co-author initiates the 3-step approval workflow (Creator - Review - Release) for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creation step as the first workflow step in the release process using an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and formal correctness and completes the review task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, completing the release task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the approval workflow, causing the workflow to be canceled for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new version of a released document is automatically created in editing status when revisions are triggered.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment (controlled sub-document) is created and added to a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is created and added to a document without affecting the release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted directly from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing document suggesting modifications without affecting the document content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, marking it as completed and notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically generates a request for validity extension 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser or workflow participants confirm the extended validity of a document, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request for override to invalidate a released document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The override workflow is completed and the document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request for reactivation to re-validate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the invalidated document and restoring authorizations and distribution settings.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to a document's distribution list for email notification or acknowledgement.

evts.name: send_distribution_email
evts.description: Upon release of a new document version, email notifications are automatically sent to users assigned to Distribution by email.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, persons and user groups in the Distribution for acknowledgement are automatically requested by email to confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A reader confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via the workflow-supported acknowledgement process.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: A document is physically deleted from the system after the archive duration has expired.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language for language-dependent display.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: A reviewer checks the translated version of a document for correctness.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the translated version of a document, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: create_reference_to_document
evts.description: A reference is created from a local client document to the original document in a multi-client system.

o2o.description: A document can have one or more controlled attachments that are subject to the document's release process.
A document can have one or more supplementary additional information objects that are independent of the release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within that document.
A document type can have one or more associated templates selectable when creating new document objects.
Each document has a distribution list specifying user groups and persons to be informed about releases.
A document can be linked to organizational units within the company.
A document can be linked to business processes defined in process management.
A document can be linked to risk objects in the system.
A document can reference IT applications maintained as Master data.
A document can reference other documents via the references attribute.
A document in a multi-client system is associated with specific clients where it is visible.
A distribution list contains assigned user groups who receive notifications or acknowledgement requests.
A distribution list contains assigned persons who receive notifications or acknowledgement requests.
A user group contains individual persons as members who inherit the group's authorizations.
A request for validity extension is linked to the specific document whose validity needs to be checked.
A request for override is linked to the specific document to be invalidated.
A request for reactivation is linked to the specific invalidated document to be re-validated.
